name: Having Girlfriend
overview: Scripture emphasizes purity and holiness in relationships, calling believers to abstain from fornication and other defiling practices as stated in Acts 15:20. The unity of the Spirit and hope in Ephesians 4:4 undergirds the believer's calling to live in accordance with God's design. While Ephesians 5:25 exhorts husbands to love their wives sacrificially as Christ loved the church, Hebrews 13:4 upholds the honor of marriage and warns that God will judge sexual immorality. Together, these verses highlight the importance of honoring God's standards in romantic relationships, pointing toward the sanctity of marriage and the call to live in purity beforehand.
